paper_title: DART Distilling Autoregressive Reasoning to Silent Thought
caption: Accuracy and inference time on GSM8K with varying C, the number of ST tokens.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of ST tokens (C) and two performance metrics—accuracy (%) and inference time (ms)—on the GSM8K benchmark, as described in the paper “DART: Distilling Autoregressive Reasoning to Silent Thought.” The x-axis, labeled “ST Token Number C,” spans from 0 to 30 with tick marks at intervals of 5. The left y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 36 to 43 with tick marks at intervals of 1. The right y-axis, labeled “Inference time (ms)”, ranges from 33 to 40 with tick marks at intervals of 1. Two lines are plotted: the blue line with circular markers represents accuracy (%), which starts at approximately 36.8% at C=0, rises sharply to 39.7% at C=2, peaks at 42.0% at C=5, dips slightly to 41.2% at C=10, rises again to 42.7% at C=20, and then declines slightly to 42.1% at C=30. The red line with square markers represents inference time (ms), which begins at approximately 36.5 ms at C=0, increases gradually to 36.8 ms at C=5, dips slightly to 36.6 ms at C=10, and then rises slowly to 37.0 ms at C=30.
